title: Droplet breakup in HIT
subtitle: Direct numerical simulation data of a liquid droplet breaking up in forced homogeneous isotropic turbulence at Weber number 15
description: Direct numerical simulation data of a liquid droplet breaking up in forced homogeneous isotropic turbulence at Weber number 15. The dataset provides volume-fraction, pressure, and velocity fields over 81 snapshots.
keywords: interface dynamics, flow-field learning, VOF, droplet breakup, homogeneous isotropic turbulence, DNS analysis
file_format:
File format: custom binary
Directory structure: dataset/data, dataset/info.json, dataset/README.md, dataset/load_example.py
Loading script: load_example.py
Notes for custom binary files:
      "header_bytes": 244,
      "dtype": "little-endian float32",
      "cell_shape": [256, 256, 256],
      "scalar_shape": [256, 256, 256],
      "velocity_shape": [3, 256, 256, 256],
      "reshape_order": "C"
contributors: Changxiao Shao, Kun Luo, Yue Yang, Jianren Fan
